snapshot_rule: latest complete UE feedback in each floor-aligned time bin; if multiple gNB observations remain for one UE/time bin, keep the latest raw timestamp

quality_controller.effective_capacity_rule: sum(top rb_available per-band rates) divided by active UE count in the same (timestamp, serving_gnb) snapshot
quality_controller.ewma_rule: per-UE alpha profile; uniform mode uses 0.65 * previous + 0.35 * current

postprocess_variant.name: p3_6q4_dual_candidate_threshold_nudge_bundle
postprocess_variant.intent: apply the smallest late-window-only ue4 threshold nudge on top of the l-4 tie-split regime, so the existing dual-candidate split may cross from zero-gain tie to true positive gain
